instrument_name: MCL 421.41 employer definition (ag/domestic)
figure_or_rule_carried: Agricultural: 10+ individuals in 20 weeks or cash remuneration >= 20,000 USD in a quarter; domestic service: cash remuneration >= 1,000 USD in a quarter (current or preceding year)

instrument_name: G.S. 110-136.6 amount to be withheld (child support IWO)
figure_or_rule_carried: Payor processing fee 2.00 USD per withholding unless waived; cap 40% of disposable income (one order); multiple orders 45% (supporting spouse/dependents) or 50% (not). 110-136.5/.7/.8 not read

instrument_name: G.S. 96-1(b)(11) employer / employing unit definition (NC UI)
figure_or_rule_carried: NC UI employer = employer under FUTA s.3306 (plus 3309 governmental/nonprofit/tribe units); statute text read; DES registration page not read

instrument_name: G.S. 96-1(b)(2) average weekly insured wage definition
figure_or_rule_carried: Definition only: total wages of insured employers / avg monthly insured employment / 52. The wage-base multiplier (G.S. 96-9) and DES LMI figure were NOT read, so derivation of the 2026 base is not completed

instrument_name: G.S. 96-9.3 determination of taxable wages (NC UI wage base rule)
figure_or_rule_carried: NC taxable wages = greater of FUTA s.3306 wages or 50% of average yearly insured wage (avg weekly wage on computation date x 52) rounded to nearest 100 USD. Numeric 2026 avg weekly wage not obtained (DES LMI not read), so the 2026 base is not re-derived here

instrument_name: G.S. 75-65 protection from security breaches (NC)
figure_or_rule_carried: Notice to affected persons without unreasonable delay; AG Consumer Protection Division notified; if >1,000 persons notified, also AG and nationwide consumer reporting agencies

instrument_name: G.S. 9-32 discharge of juror unlawful (NC)
figure_or_rule_carried: Jury duty: job protection only (no discharge/demotion; civil damages, reinstatement); text is silent on pay (no pay obligation stated). Military/voting leave statutes not read

instrument_name: NCDOR eNC3 W-2 file layout specification (TY2025 rev 09-26-2025)
figure_or_rule_carried: NC W-2 file = fixed-field .txt following SSA EFW2 plus NCDOR fields; RE/RW/RS (state) records; file name suggested W2REPORT.txt. TY2026 (9-2026) spec NOT read: tab content not rendered, direct URL ty2026enc3w2pdf returned 404

instrument_name: G.S. 95-25.3(b) student/learner rate rounding (NC)
figure_or_rule_carried: 90% of the (a) rate, rounded to the LOWEST NICKEL: 0.90 x 7.25 = 6.525 -> 6.50 USD/h (derived arithmetically; no NCDOL hourly publication found)

instrument_name: NC DES: Understanding Wage Audit Notices vs Separation Notices (employer flyer)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer duty is reactive: when a claim is filed DES sends a Separation Notice request; employer must give reason for separation, last day worked and final pay details by the deadline. No standing employer-to-employee separation notice located on an official host; 04 NCAC 24G .0102 (COVID-era) seen only in secondary sources and not verified

instrument_name: 2026 PA 39 (Enrolled SB 301) amending MCL 206.30 and 206.623
figure_or_rule_carried: Approved 2026-07-21, effective 2026-07-22. MCL 206.30(1)(ee): for tax years beginning after 2025-12-31 and before 2029-01-01 deduct federal qualified tips (IRC s.224) and qualified overtime (IRC s.225); nonresidents only for services performed in MI. Personal exemption base stated 3,700 USD (indexed under 206.30a). Level: assessment (taxable-income computation); withholding effect not stated in act

instrument_name: MCL 552.609 / 552.611 SPTEA income withholding notice (payer remittance, binding date)
figure_or_rule_carried: Withheld income paid to FOC/SDU within 3 days after withholding; order binding on source of income 7 days after service of notice; order has priority over other legal process. Payer processing fee NOT found in 552.609/.611 (552.607 and 552.626 also read: no fee); fee remains open

instrument_name: EDD DI Contribution Rates and Benefit Amounts (2026)
figure_or_rule_carried: 2026 maximum weekly benefit amount 1,765 USD; max benefit 91,780 = 1,765 x 52 (checked); employee contribution rate 1.3% (eff. 2026-01-01)

instrument_name: EDD Tax-Rated Employers page: 2027 UI/ETT/SDI rates
article_or_section: SDI rate section; UI rate schedule 2027
figure_or_rule_carried: 2027 SDI withholding rate 1.4 percent (2026 was 1.3%); all wages subject to SDI; also 2027 UI schedule F+ (1.5%-6.2%, 7,000 wage limit) and ETT 0.1%

instrument_name: Family Code 5235(d) employer fee on earnings assignment order
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer may deduct 1.50 USD per payment made under the order; SDU remittance once operational; substitution of payee forwarded within 10 days

instrument_name: Labor Code 1725.5(f) public works registration de minimis thresholds
figure_or_rule_carried: DIR contractor registration not required for public works projects of 25,000 USD or less (construction/alteration/demolition/installation/repair) or 15,000 USD or less (maintenance); registration/renewal fee up to 800 USD set by DIR

instrument_name: Labor Code 860 agricultural overtime phase-in (AB 1066)
figure_or_rule_carried: Fully phased in: >8h/day or >40h/week at 1.5x commencing 2022-01-01 for employers with 26+ employees; commencing 2025-01-01 for employers with 25 or fewer (earlier steps 9.5/55 from 2019, 9/50 from 2020, 8.5/45 from 2021, with +3 years for small employers)

instrument_name: Labor Code 1400.5 Cal/WARN definitions
figure_or_rule_carried: Covered establishment = 75 or more persons employed (incl. within preceding 12 months); mass layoff = 50 or more employees in any 30-day period at a covered establishment

instrument_name: UIC 675 and 682 CA UI employer thresholds (general, domestic)
figure_or_rule_carried: General employer: 1+ employee and wages over 100 USD in any calendar quarter (current or preceding year); domestic service in private home/college club: cash wages of 1,000 USD or more in any quarter (current or preceding year). Agricultural (UIC 678) and nonprofit thresholds NOT read

instrument_name: AB 781 (2025-26) HSA conformity bill status
figure_or_rule_carried: Not enacted: AB 781 (DeMaio) is an Inactive Bill - Died 2026-01-31 pursuant to Art. IV Sec 10(c); hearing canceled 2025-04-21. No other enacted HSA-conformity act was located (only this bill checked); FTB 2026 Schedule CA instructions not read. Level: assessment

instrument_name: EDD DE 8300 Electronic Filing Guide for the Quarterly Wage and Withholding Program (Rev. 12, 7-24)
figure_or_rule_carried: Bulk DE 9C return file accepted as XML (App. B), ICESA (App. C/D no-payroll) or MMREF-1 (RE/RS/RST records); guide Rev. 12 (7-24) - a newer revision was not checked

instrument_name: TWC Tax Report & Payment Due Dates (quarterly UI)
figure_or_rule_carried: Quarterly wage report and tax due last day of month after quarter end: Apr 30, Jul 31, Oct 31, Jan 31. Records-retention rule (40 TAC 815.107) not read

instrument_name: Texas Family Code 234.101-.104 state directory of new hires
figure_or_rule_carried: For new-hire reporting 'employee' = IRC 3401(c) employee OR an independent contractor as defined by the IRS (also TNC drivers); employers report each newly hired/rehired employee to the state directory per 42 USC 653a

instrument_name: Civil Practice and Remedies Code 122.001 juror employment protection
figure_or_rule_carried: Jury service: permanent employee may not be discharged/threatened/coerced; right to return to same employment on notice; text is silent on pay. Military leave (Gov. Code 431.005/437.204) NOT read

instrument_name: TUCA (Labor Code) 201.081-201.082 definition of wages / exceptions
figure_or_rule_carried: Wages = all remuneration for personal services (201.081); 201.082 exceptions read in full contain no exclusion for employee elective 401(k) deferrals or IRC s.125 reductions (only payments to/from exempt 401(a) trusts); TWC guidance not obtained

instrument_name: TWC Proposed and Recently Adopted Rules page: Ch. 815 wage-record data elements (SB 1786, HB 2, HB 120)
figure_or_rule_carried: Status PROPOSED, not adopted on this page: TWC proposes 40 TAC ch.815 amendments for new employer wage-record data elements; comments due 2026-09-07. The Oct 1 / Nov 1 2026 effective dates on the same page belong to the Child Care Services rules, NOT ch.815. Adoption notice and layout not found; level: employer reporting

instrument_name: ORC 4141.01(G) wages / taxable wage base
figure_or_rule_carried: Statutory fixed wage base, not indexed: 9,000 USD from 1995-01-01; 9,500 USD from 2018-01-01; 9,000 USD from 2020-01-01 (in force for 2026)

instrument_name: ORC 4115.071 prevailing wage coordinator / certified payroll content
figure_or_rule_carried: Contractors submit complete payroll for each pay date to the public authority's prevailing wage coordinator: employee name, current address, last four SSN digits, hours per day and week, hourly rate, job classification, fringe payments, deductions. 2026 coverage-threshold adjustment (4115.03) NOT read

instrument_name: ORC 3121.03 withholding or deduction notices for support
figure_or_rule_carried: Withholding begins no later than 14 business days after the notice is mailed/transmitted, or for employers no later than the first pay period after 14 business days; continues until further notice. Statutory priority between orders (3121.034) and general deduction-authorisation rules (4113.15) NOT read

instrument_name: ORC 4113.15 semimonthly payment of wages (Ohio)
figure_or_rule_carried: Wages must be paid by the 1st (for 1st-15th of prior month) and the 15th (for 16th-end of prior month) of each month; section text contains no provision on payment medium (direct deposit/paycard/check) - inspected directly (search for direct deposit, electronic, card, check, cash: none)

instrument_name: NYS-45-I (1/26) Instructions for Form NYS-45
authority: NY Dept of Taxation and Finance
article_or_section: NYS-45-I (1/26), Part B and due dates
figure_or_rule_carried: NYS-45 is a quarterly combined return (Parts A UI, B withholding reconciliation, C employee wage detail) due last day of month after quarter end; no separate annual NYS-45 reconciliation found in the instructions; annual UI items go on IA7/IA7A; Q4 withholding overpayment is refunded automatically

instrument_name: CPLR 5231(b) income execution limits (NY)
figure_or_rule_carried: Nothing withheld unless weekly disposable earnings exceed the GREATER of 30x the federal minimum hourly wage or 30x the state minimum hourly wage in Labor Law 652 (so the state minimum applies when higher); cap is the lesser of 25% of disposable earnings or the excess over that floor; 10% of gross for the 10% execution. The clause as read does not name a Labor Law 652 region

instrument_name: Tax Law 692(c)-(f) warrant and execution for unpaid NY tax
authority: NY State Senate Open Legislation (Tax Law)
figure_or_rule_carried: DTF issues a warrant after notice and demand; once filed with the county clerk it is a judgment and the sheriff/DTF officer executes it 'in the same manner prescribed by law in respect to executions issued against' property, i.e. CPLR 5231 income-execution limits apply to wages (not separately read per DTF forms)

instrument_name: IT-225-I (2025) New York additions and subtractions: code A-101
authority: NY Dept of Taxation and Finance
figure_or_rule_carried: A-101 New York City flexible benefits program (IRC 125): amount deducted/deferred under an NYC (or certain other NYC public employer) flexible benefits program shown on W-2 is an ADDITION modification on IT-201/IT-203/IT-204. Edition read is (2025); level: assessment

instrument_name: Labor Law 192 cash payment of wages (NY), revision 2024-03-15
authority: NY State Senate Open Legislation (Labor Law)
figure_or_rule_carried: No employer may deposit net wage in a bank/financial institution without the employee's advance written consent (exempt: executive/admin/professional earning over 1,300 USD/week; farm workers). 12 NYCRR Part 192 (paycard rules) NOT read

instrument_name: Labor Law 195(3) wage statement (NY)
authority: NY State Senate Open Legislation (Labor Law)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer must furnish each employee a statement with every payment of wages; the section text contains no occurrence of 'electronic' (inspected directly), so electronic delivery rests on DOL guidance which was not obtained

instrument_name: FL DOR Reemployment Tax XML package v2026 1.0, RT_changes.xlsx (change log)
figure_or_rule_carried: v2026 1.0: 257 change rows, ALL in User Information (guide/XPath docs/samples; 221 Changed, 18 Inserted, 8 Deleted, 6 Renamed, 3 Added) and none in Schema_Reemployment; RSI replaces BSWA as intake provider. URL is the package landing page (zip retrieved 2026-11-02, inspected directly)

instrument_name: Fla. Stat. 501.171 (2026 Florida Statutes), history incl. s. 9, ch. 2026-52
figure_or_rule_carried: In force: the 2026 Florida Statutes text carries 'History - ... s. 9, ch. 2026-52'. Notice to the Department of Legal Affairs for breaches of 500+ individuals no later than 30 days after determination (15-day extension possible). Which subsection ch. 2026-52 s.9 changed was not isolated (session-law text not read: laws.flrules.org/2026/52 rendered blank)

instrument_name: 35 ILCS 5/201(b)(5.4) individual income tax rate (text per P.A. 104-468)
figure_or_rule_carried: Individual/trust/estate rate 4.95% of net income for taxable years beginning on or after 2017-07-01; no different 2027 rate appears in the section text as currently published (header: Text of Section from P.A. 104-468). Level: assessment and withholding base rate

instrument_name: 820 ILCS 405/235 Illinois UI taxable wage base by year
figure_or_rule_carried: Statutory wage base: 2026 = 14,250 USD; 2027 and each later year = 14,592 USD (2024 13,590; 2025 13,916). The 405/235 formula gap is closed; the IDES 2027 rate chart (December 2026) is still unpublished

instrument_name: 815 ILCS 505/2RR use of Social Security numbers (IL)
figure_or_rule_carried: A person may not publicly post/display an SSN, print it on access cards, transmit it over the Internet unless secure/encrypted, or print it on materials mailed to the individual unless law requires it. Pay statements are not named in the section text read; 815 ILCS 530 (PIPA breach notice) NOT read
